meta.title: Government and public services — Mallacoota
meta.purpose: Practical directory seed for Love Mallacoota. Not a dump of every Victorian department.
meta.rule: Every phone, address, hours and URL has a source. Unconfirmed facts are in flags.
meta.emergency: In an emergency always call Triple Zero (000). Do not use station or brigade numbers first.

entities.notes: Certified aerodrome about 7 km southwest of town. Supports Air Ambulance Victoria, Victoria Police Airwing, aerial firefighting. DEECA Airbase apron on Taxiways Bravo/Charlie — operational presence, not a public counter. Airside restricted.

entities.name: Ambulance Victoria — Mallacoota branch
entities.notes: Remote branch staffed by Ambulance Community Officers (ACOs) on-call. No public branch phone published on ambulance.vic.gov.au. VCAT 2025 described a proposed rebuild on the existing station site. AV Auxiliary is fundraising, not the service.

sources.facts: Mallacoota is a remote AV branch with ACOs; nearest hospital ~2 hours in NSW
Existing ambulance station 82 Betka Road Mallacoota VIC 3892; corner Betka Road and Bucknall Street

entities.name: Australian Volunteer Coast Guard — VF15 Mallacoota
entities.operator: Australian Volunteer Coast Guard Association Inc (Victorian MSAR framework)
entities.notes: Official Victorian MSAR unit for Mallacoota. Volunteer incorporated association, not a government department. Distinct from Mallacoota Marine Search and Rescue Inc, which is not operational. Operations: marine emergencies up to 30 nm; trailerable 8.5 m and 6.5 m vessels.

entities.name: Parks Victoria — Croajingolong / Cape Howe / Gabo Island
entities.local_presence_note: Parks surround the town. No public-facing Parks Victoria counter in Mallacoota on parks.vic.gov.au. Official Croajingolong contact block: Gale Hill Track, Wingan River VIC 3891.
entities.address: Gale Hill Track, Wingan River VIC 3891 (park contact block, not a town office)

hours.call_centre: Monday–Saturday (including public holidays) 10:00–16:00. Sundays 10:00–16:00 only in peak season (1 January–22 February and Easter Sunday).

entities.notes: Cape Howe Marine National Park (~15 km east) is a no-take marine park. Cape Conran is a separate park further west with no Mallacoota office — omit from local listings.

sources.facts: Park description; contact Gale Hill Track Wingan River VIC 3891, 13 1963
